detaileddescription.para: This function calls for each file that needs to be backed up to recover from the specified checkpoint.
The checkpoint is given by . If is 0, the last checkpoint will be backed up; if it is 1, next to last, and so on.
The caller is supposed to call box_backup_stop() after he's done copying the files.
